svg.text: THE GREAT GATE in the water
the boat from the Beach comes in from the south, through the gate, up the bay
N ↑ one cell = one 3.5 m battle square; a plot = 12 x 12 squares
THE BIG NUMBER = the plot’s level
1 level = 1.75 m. 0 = the sea. 18 = the crater, 31.5 m.
Darker = lower, lighter = higher. Downhill is the bay.
THE WAYS (every one on whole squares)
Straight legs, right-angle turns, no leg over
8 squares (28 m). Checked by the script.
A LEDGE: walk off, fall, no way back up
Each is 2 levels (3.5 m) or more. The walker’s
jump tops out at 1.46 m. The arrow = the fall.
main way: the pier to the crater
the High Town to the castle yard, through the east gate
the Waterfront to the Village to the Jungle
The West Steps + the Main Gate
the Waterfront, the Samurai Quarter, the castle’s south gate
the Dinosaur Park up the volcano’s east flank to the crater
the castle garden to the Bamboo Wood
the Bamboo Wood, the hidden shrine, the Black Cape
the Cherry Wood, the Lava Field, the Hot Spring, the Terraces
KATANA ISLAND, the plan: 29 plots, six districts, every square drawn
The volcano stands in the middle of the north side and is seen from everywhere. The land falls from it to the bay in the south-west.
